WITH completed AS (
  SELECT
    order_delivered_customer_date,
    CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_late
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(is_late)::DOUBLE AS late_share,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM completed
  WHERE order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(is_late)::DOUBLE AS late_share,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM completed
  WHERE order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-21'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-05-28'
),
baseline_periods AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', order_delivered_customer_date) AS period_start,
    AVG(is_late)::DOUBLE AS period_share
  FROM completed
  WHERE order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-21'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-05-28'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', order_delivered_customer_date)
),
spread_calc AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 2 THEN STDDEV(period_share) ELSE NULL END AS spread
  FROM baseline_periods
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.late_share, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(b.late_share, 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(s.spread, 4) AS spread,
  w.n AS n,
  b.n AS n_baseline
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b, spread_calc s;
